system.boundary: Build an open electric-aircraft mission and powertrain plant in Simulink/Simscape.
engineering_objects: Build an open electric-aircraft mission and powertrain plant in Simulink/Simscape.
The plant must use finite aircraft and battery mass so that battery capacity and payload both affect the required power and achievable mission range.
Treat the requested profile as the mission/load demand followed by the open plant.
physical_paths: Prescribed range, replayed battery trajectories, and disconnected electrical or aerodynamic paths are invalid.

Keep voltages, currents, charge, distance, and time finite; show nonzero motor demand and switched auxiliary-load activity; and retain connected flight-cycle, aerodynamic, mechanical, high-voltage electrical, and low-voltage distribution mechanisms.

functional_paths: Couple a height-based flight-cycle command, an aerodynamic aircraft load with lift and drag, thrust and propeller/load-torque conversion, a controlled electric motor and drive, a high-voltage battery, DC conversion and distribution, and switched low-voltage lamp, heater, and avionics loads.
This is not an autopilot task: do not claim or fabricate a flight-control computer, nonlinear-dynamic-inversion controller, or closed-loop flight-path controller.
